title: EXP-CRYPTO-6505c6 certificate and 20-file audit bundle schema (structural preparation only)
description: Schema for the statement/scope/quantifier/source/anchor/dependency/status structure a future certificate must have, and the structural constraints on the 20-file audit output bundle this specification declares. This schema validates STRUCTURE only. Passing this schema never discharges a mathematical premise; see checker-specification.md soundness_boundary.

certificate.description: One certificate unit. Content fields (statement text, actual sources, actual dependency proofs) are never fabricated by this schema; it constrains shape, not truth.

cert_id.description: Unique explicit certificate-ID marker, referenced identically by dependency-dag.yaml and checker-results.yaml.

statement.description: Exact mathematical statement the certificate claims to establish, at its declared scope. Must not be a paraphrase that silently widens scope.

scope.description: Exact case/base/family/parameter-locus binding for which the statement is claimed.

quantifier.description: Exact quantifier order and range for the statement (e.g. 'for every n>=1 and all (Q,R)'). Never inferred from a finite sample.

source.description: Primary sources actually read and matched, with locator (theorem/definition/section) and provenance. Empty array is valid and means no source has been read for this certificate yet.

anchor.description: Anchor into certificate-bundle.md identifying where the full certificate text/proof artifact lives. Must not be dangling; checker-results.yaml verifies resolution.

dependency.description: cert_id list of certificates this one depends on. Forms edges of dependency-dag.yaml; must not introduce a cycle.

status.description: Exactly the frozen specification's audit-time status enum. This preparation task assigns no value to any real certificate; the enum is declared here for future use.

audit_bundle_contract.description: Structural constraints on the 20-file root output bundle a future genuinely-claimed audit will produce. This preparation task produces none of these 20 files; it produces the nine implementation/ preparation files listed in the handoff instead.
audit_bundle_contract.hash_index_rule: Hash every materialized root file except artifact-sha256.json itself, which the archive step binds instead.
audit_bundle_contract.duplicate_or_dangling_anchor_rule: Reject any cert_id referenced in dependency-dag.yaml or checker-results.yaml that is not defined exactly once in certificate-bundle.md.
